note: Draft food master table for development. Allergens, record choices and unit weights need dietitian review; unit weights are typical values to verify against USDA FoodData Central portion data. ingredient_record = USDA per-100 g record used for recipe maths. No IFCT links. FM-0.3.0 (16 Oct 2026): 35 more vegetables, leafy greens, roots and pulses/legumes added, each mapped to one USDA record; the vegetables people cook most in India were missing (capsicum, brinjal, karela, carrot and others). Names and aliases (Hindi, regional) need dietitian review; only carrot, beetroot and capsicum have a unit weight, the rest have none until a dietitian enters one. dry_weight = the record is for the dry, uncooked pulse: the AI is never asked to build a recipe around it (it needs soaking and boiling), approved recipes may use it. FM-0.3.2: rice now has a USDA record so approved recipes (khichdi, pulao, lemon rice) can use it; besan and suji added. The AI is never asked to draft around them. FM-0.4.0 (26 Oct 2026): foods and unit weights for the Healthful Diet book recipes. Book-only foods have match_in_chat false, so they never change how a chat message is read; proxies say which USDA record stands in and why. Every record, weight, proxy and allergen here needs dietitian review.
